transcript.message:
Hi Chloe, this is Sarah Thompson from ClearPath Financial Solutions—thank you so much for answering the call. I really appreciate you making time to talk.  

First, I want to say how much I value your willingness to work this out. I know these conversations can feel stressful, and the fact that you’re reaching out to take care of things speaks volumes. I’m here to help make this as straightforward and manageable as possible.  

Do you have a few minutes to go over your account and talk through some options? I’d like to understand your situation a bit so we can find a plan that fits your life right now.  

And just so you know—this is a debt collection call, and everything we discuss is confidential. My goal isn’t to add pressure, but to partner with you on a realistic path forward. How does that sound?
